requirement: The Data Protection Board of India must be established by the Central Government.
checkable_test: Verify if the Central Government has established the Data Protection Board of India as defined in the DPDP Act 2023.
applicability: Applicable to all entities subject to the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This requirement is directly derived from the definition of 'Board' in the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Consent Manager must be registered with the Data Protection Board of India and act as a single point of contact for managing consent.
checkable_test: Verify if the entity has a registered Consent Manager acting as a single point of contact for managing consent.
applicability: Applicable to entities that collect and process personal data.
notes: This requirement is directly derived from the definition of 'Consent Manager' in the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Significant Data Fiduciaries must appoint a Data Protection Officer as required by law.
checkable_test: Check if the organization has appointed a Data Protection Officer as required by law.
applicability: Applicable to Significant Data Fiduciaries.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the definition of a Data Protection Officer under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must ensure that personal data is erased or restricted when no longer needed for the specified purpose.
checkable_test: Verify if the organization provides a specified purpose for data processing and ensures data is erased or restricted when no longer needed.
applicability: Applicable to Data Fiduciaries who provide a specified purpose for data processing.
notes: This obligation is tied to the requirement for Data Fiduciaries to provide a specified purpose and manage data retention accordingly.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must ensure that personal data is protected against unauthorized processing, accidental disclosure, or loss.
checkable_test: Check if the organization has implemented measures to protect personal data against unauthorized processing, accidental disclosure, or loss.
applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the definition of a personal data breach and the need for security safeguards.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must ensure that personal data is retained only for the specified purpose and erased when no longer needed.
checkable_test: Verify if the organization retains personal data only for the specified purpose and ensures erasure when no longer needed.
applicability: Applicable to Data Fiduciaries who process personal data.
notes: This obligation is tied to the definition of processing and the requirement to retain data only for the specified purpose.

requirement: Significant Data Fiduciaries must be notified by the Central Government under section 10.
checkable_test: Check if the organization is classified as a Significant Data Fiduciary and if it complies with the notification requirements under section 10.
applicability: Applicable to Significant Data Fiduciaries.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the definition of a Significant Data Fiduciary and the requirement for notification by the Central Government.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must ensure that personal data is retained only for the purpose for which it was collected.
checkable_test: Verify if the organization retains personal data only for the purpose for which it was collected.
applicability: Applicable to Data Fiduciaries processing personal data within India.
notes: This obligation is tied to the requirement that data processing within India must be for the purpose for which it was collected.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must process personal data only for a lawful purpose as defined by the DPDP Act 2023.
checkable_test: Verify if the Data Fiduciary's processing of personal data is limited to lawful purposes as per the DPDP Act 2023.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries processing personal data in India.
notes: This obligation is tied to the definition of a Data Fiduciary under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Every request for consent from a Data Principal must be accompanied by a notice informing the Data Principal of the purpose of processing.
checkable_test: Check if all consent requests include a notice describing the purpose of data processing.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries seeking consent for data processing.
notes: This requirement applies to all data processing activities requiring consent under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must provide a Data Principal with the means to make a complaint to the Board.
checkable_test: Verify if the Data Fiduciary provides clear instructions on how to file a complaint with the Board.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries processing personal data in India.
notes: This obligation is part of the Data Principal's right to complain under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must accompany or precede a request for personal data with a notice describing the personal data and the purpose of its processing.
checkable_test: Check if all data processing requests include a notice describing the data and its purpose.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries processing personal data for KYC requirements.
notes: This requirement applies specifically to data processing for KYC under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must inform a Data Principal of the right to withdraw consent and the consequences of withdrawal.
checkable_test: Verify if the Data Fiduciary provides information on how to withdraw consent and its effects.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries processing personal data with prior consent.
notes: This obligation is tied to the right of Data Principals to withdraw consent under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must inform a Data Principal of the purpose of processing personal data upon the commencement of the DPDP Act 2023.
checkable_test: Check if the Data Fiduciary provides information on the purpose of data processing to Data Principals who gave consent before the Act's commencement.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries who processed data before the DPDP Act 2023 came into effect.
notes: This requirement applies to Data Principals who gave consent prior to the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Data Fiduciary shall provide the Data Principal with the option to access the notice in English or any language specified in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution.
checkable_test: Check if the notice provides the option to access in English or any language from the Eighth Schedule.
applicability: All data fiduciaries required to provide notice to data principals.

requirement: Consent must be free, specific, informed, unconditional, and unambiguous, with a clear affirmative action, and limited to the necessary personal data for the specified purpose.
checkable_test: Verify that consent is specific, informed, and limited to necessary data for the specified purpose.
applicability: All data fiduciaries seeking consent for processing personal data.

requirement: Consent given for processing personal data shall not include any invalid terms, such as waiving the right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Board of India.
checkable_test: Check if any part of the consent includes invalid terms, such as waiving the right to file a complaint.
applicability: All data fiduciaries seeking consent for processing personal data.

requirement: Every request for consent shall be presented in clear and plain language, with the option to access the request in English or any language specified in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution.
checkable_test: Verify that consent requests are presented in clear and plain language with the option to access in English or any language from the Eighth Schedule.
applicability: All data fiduciaries seeking consent for processing personal data.

requirement: The Data Principal shall have the right to withdraw consent at any time, with the ease of doing so being comparable to the ease with which such consent was given.
checkable_test: Check if the withdrawal of consent is as easy as the initial consent was obtained.
applicability: All data fiduciaries processing personal data based on consent.

requirement: The Data Principal shall have the right to access the notice in English or any language specified in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution, along with the contact details of the Data Protection Officer or authorized person.
checkable_test: Verify that the notice includes the option to access in English or any language from the Eighth Schedule and provides contact details of the Data Protection Officer or authorized person.
applicability: All data fiduciaries required to provide notice to data principals.

requirement: The withdrawal of consent shall not affect the legality of processing of personal data based on consent before its withdrawal.
checkable_test: Check if the withdrawal of consent does not affect the legality of processing before withdrawal.
applicability: All data fiduciaries processing personal data based on consent.

requirement: If the Data Principal withdraws consent, the Data Fiduciary may stop enabling the use of the service for placing orders but may not stop processing for goods already ordered and paid for.
checkable_test: Verify that withdrawal of consent does not affect the processing of goods already ordered and paid for.
applicability: All data fiduciaries processing personal data for fulfilling supply orders.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must cease processing personal data of a Data Principal who has withdrawn consent, unless processing is required or authorized by law.
checkable_test: Verify if the document states that processing must cease upon withdrawal of consent, unless required by law.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries handling personal data of Data Principals.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the withdrawal of consent and cessation of processing.

requirement: A Data Principal may give, manage, review, or withdraw consent through a Consent Manager.
checkable_test: Verify if the document allows a Data Principal to manage or withdraw consent through a Consent Manager.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries handling personal data of Data Principals.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the right of the Data Principal to manage or withdraw consent.

requirement: A Consent Manager must be accountable to the Data Principal and act on her behalf in accordance with prescribed obligations.
checkable_test: Verify if the document states that the Consent Manager must act on behalf of the Data Principal in accordance with prescribed obligations.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries using a Consent Manager.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the accountability of the Consent Manager to the Data Principal.

requirement: A Consent Manager must be registered with the Board in accordance with prescribed conditions.
checkable_test: Verify if the document states that the Consent Manager must be registered with the Board in accordance with prescribed conditions.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries using a Consent Manager.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the registration of the Consent Manager with the Board.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must prove that a notice was given and consent was obtained in accordance with the Act and rules, if a question arises in a proceeding.
checkable_test: Verify if the document states that the Data Fiduciary must prove that notice was given and consent was obtained in accordance with the Act and rules.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries handling personal data of Data Principals.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the requirement to prove that notice and consent were properly given.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary may process personal data only for the specified purpose for which the Data Principal has voluntarily provided her data, unless she has indicated non-consent.
checkable_test: Verify if the document states that data may be processed only for the specified purpose unless the Data Principal has indicated non-consent.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries handling personal data of Data Principals.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the purpose limitation of data processing.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must process personal data only for purposes explicitly permitted by law, including providing services, fulfilling legal obligations, and safeguarding employer interests.
checkable_test: Verify that the document specifies permitted purposes for data processing as outlined in the DPDP Act 2023.
applicability: All data fiduciaries processing personal data for permitted purposes.
notes: This requirement covers multiple clauses that define permissible data processing purposes under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary shall protect personal data in its possession or under its control by taking reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breaches.
checkable_test: Verify that the document specifies the use of reasonable security safeguards to prevent data breaches.
applicability: All Data Fiduciaries processing personal data.

requirement: In the event of a personal data breach, the Data Fiduciary shall notify the Board and each affected Data Principal of the breach.
checkable_test: Verify that the document specifies procedures for notifying the Board and affected Data Principals in case of a data breach.
applicability: All Data Fiduciaries processing personal data.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary shall erase personal data upon the Data Principal withdrawing her consent.
checkable_test: Verify that the document specifies the obligation to erase personal data upon withdrawal of consent.
applicability: All Data Fiduciaries processing personal data.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary shall retain personal data for a period of ten years beyond the closing of an account for compliance with legal requirements.
checkable_test: Verify that the document specifies the retention of personal data for a period of ten years beyond account closure for legal compliance.
applicability: Data Fiduciaries subject to legal retention requirements.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary shall no longer retain personal data once the purpose for which it was collected has been fulfilled.
checkable_test: Verify that the document specifies the obligation to delete personal data once the purpose of processing has been fulfilled.
applicability: All Data Fiduciaries processing personal data.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must cease processing personal data if the Data Principal does not exercise her rights for a prescribed period.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies a time period for inactivity before ceasing data processing.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries who process personal data based on user inactivity.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must establish a time period for the retention of personal data and erase it upon expiry.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies a time period for data retention and erasure.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries who retain personal data for a specific period.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must publish business contact information for a Data Protection Officer or a person who can answer questions from Data Principals.
checkable_test: Verify if the document provides contact details for a Data Protection Officer or a representative.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries that have a Data Protection Officer.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must establish an effective mechanism to redress grievances of Data Principals.
checkable_test: Check if the document outlines a grievance redressal mechanism.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must obtain verifiable consent from the parent or lawful guardian of a child or person with disability before processing their personal data.
checkable_test: Verify if the document requires verifiable consent from a parent or guardian for children or persons with disabilities.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries processing data of children or persons with disabilities.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must not process personal data of children if it is likely to cause detrimental effects on their well-being.
checkable_test: Check if the document prohibits processing personal data of children that may harm their well-being.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries processing data of children.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must not engage in tracking or behavioral monitoring of children or targeted advertising directed at children.
checkable_test: Verify if the document prohibits tracking or targeted advertising of children.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries processing data of children.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must ensure that processing of personal data of children is done in a manner that is verifiably safe.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies measures to ensure verifiably safe processing of children's data.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries processing children's personal data.
notes: This clause establishes a general obligation for data fiduciaries to ensure safe processing of children's data, which can be checked against governance documents.

requirement: The Central Government may exempt a data fiduciary from certain obligations if it ensures verifiably safe processing of children's data.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the age threshold for exemption from obligations related to children's data processing, if any.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries subject to government exemption notifications.
notes: This clause allows for exemptions from certain obligations if the government determines processing is verifiably safe, which can be checked against governance documents.

requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must appoint a Data Protection Officer.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the appointment of a Data Protection Officer.
applicability: Applies to significant data fiduciaries.
notes: This clause mandates the appointment of a Data Protection Officer for significant data fiduciaries, which can be checked against governance documents.

requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must conduct periodic Data Protection Impact Assessments.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the conduct of periodic Data Protection Impact Assessments.
applicability: Applies to significant data fiduciaries.
notes: This clause requires significant data fiduciaries to conduct periodic Data Protection Impact Assessments, which can be checked against governance documents.

requirement: Data principals have the right to request access to their personal data from the data fiduciary.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the right of data principals to request access to their personal data.
applicability: Applies to data principals who have given consent to data fiduciaries.
notes: This clause establishes the right of data principals to request access to their personal data, which can be checked against governance documents.

requirement: A Data Principal shall have the right to correction, completion, updating and erasure of her personal data for the processing of which she has previously given consent.
checkable_test: Check if the document provides a mechanism for data principals to request correction, completion, updating, and erasure of their personal data.
applicability: Applies to all data principals who have given consent for the processing of their personal data.
notes: This obligation is tied to the right to erasure and correction of personal data under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary shall erase personal data upon receipt of a request for erasure unless retention is necessary for a specified purpose or for compliance with law.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies that data fiduciaries must erase personal data upon request unless retention is required for a specified purpose or legal compliance.
applicability: Applies to all data fiduciaries handling personal data subject to erasure requests.
notes: This obligation is tied to the right to erasure under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Principal shall have the right to grievance redressal mechanisms provided by a Data Fiduciary or Consent Manager.
checkable_test: Check if the document provides grievance redressal mechanisms for data principals regarding data fiduciary or consent manager actions.
applicability: Applies to all data principals who have interacted with data fiduciaries or consent managers.
notes: This obligation is tied to the right to grievance redressal under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary or Consent Manager shall respond to grievances within a prescribed period.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies a time limit for responding to grievances raised by data principals.
applicability: Applies to all data fiduciaries and consent managers handling grievances.
notes: This obligation is tied to the grievance redressal process under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Principal must exhaust the opportunity of redressing her grievance under this section before approaching the Board.
checkable_test: Check if the document provides a process for resolving grievances internally before allowing appeals to the Board.
applicability: Applies to all Data Principals.
notes: This requirement ensures that Data Principals follow internal grievance mechanisms before seeking external redress.

requirement: A Data Principal shall have the right to nominate any other individual to act on their behalf in the event of death or incapacity.
checkable_test: Check if the document allows for the nomination of a representative to act on behalf of the Data Principal in case of death or incapacity.
applicability: Applies to all Data Principals.
notes: This requirement ensures that Data Principals can designate a representative to manage their data rights in case of incapacitation.

requirement: The term 'incapacity' includes inability to exercise rights due to unsoundness of mind or infirmity of body.
checkable_test: Check if the document defines 'incapacity' to include mental or physical conditions that prevent the exercise of data rights.
applicability: Applies to all Data Principals.
notes: This requirement clarifies the definition of incapacity for the purpose of data rights.

requirement: A Data Principal must not register false or frivolous grievances or complaints with a Data Fiduciary or the Board.
checkable_test: Check if the document prohibits the registration of false or frivolous grievances or complaints.
applicability: Applies to all Data Principals.
notes: This requirement ensures that the grievance process is not abused by submitting false complaints.

requirement: The Central Government may restrict the transfer of personal data by a Data Fiduciary to countries outside India.
checkable_test: Check if the document provides for the possibility of government-imposed restrictions on cross-border data transfers.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries.
notes: This requirement allows the government to impose restrictions on data transfers to foreign jurisdictions.

requirement: The applicability of Indian laws providing higher protection for data transfers outside India is not restricted by this section.
checkable_test: Check if the document acknowledges that higher protections for data transfers outside India may be provided by existing Indian laws.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries.
notes: This requirement ensures that existing Indian laws on data transfer protections remain applicable.

requirement: The Central Government may notify certain Data Fiduciaries, including startups, that are exempt from specific data protection provisions.
checkable_test: Check if the document allows for the exemption of certain Data Fiduciaries, including startups, from specific data protection provisions.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries.
notes: This requirement allows for the exemption of certain entities from specific data protection obligations.

requirement: The Data Protection Board of India must include at least one expert in the field of law.
checkable_test: Verify if the Data Protection Board of India includes at least one legal expert.
applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
notes: This requirement ensures the Board has legal expertise to fulfill its duties.

requirement: The Chairperson and other Members of the Data Protection Board shall not be varied to their disadvantage after their appointment.
checkable_test: Verify if the terms of the Chairperson and Members are not varied to their disadvantage after appointment.
applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
notes: This requirement protects the terms of the Board members from being altered unfavorably.

requirement: The Chairperson and other Members of the Data Protection Board shall hold office for a term of two years and be eligible for re-appointment.
checkable_test: Verify if the term of office for the Chairperson and Members is two years with eligibility for re-appointment.
applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
notes: This requirement establishes the term and re-appointment eligibility for Board members.

requirement: The Chairperson or a Member of the Data Protection Board shall resign upon the Central Government's permission or upon expiry of three months from the notice of resignation.
checkable_test: Verify if the resignation of the Chairperson or Member is effective upon Central Government's permission or after three months.
applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
notes: This requirement outlines the conditions for resignation of Board members.

requirement: The Chairperson and Members of the Data Protection Board shall not accept employment with any Data Fiduciary against whom proceedings were initiated.
checkable_test: Verify if the Chairperson and Members of the Board accept employment with Data Fiduciaries against whom proceedings were initiated.
applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
notes: This requirement prevents conflicts of interest by prohibiting employment with entities under investigation.

requirement: The Central Government shall be informed of any defect in the appointment of a person acting as the Chairperson or other Member of the Board.
checkable_test: Verify if the Central Government is informed of any defect in the appointment of the Chairperson or Members.
applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
notes: This requirement ensures transparency in the appointment process of the Board members.

requirement: The Board may appoint officers and employees as necessary for the efficient discharge of its functions, with prior approval from the Central Government.
checkable_test: Verify if the Board has the authority to appoint officers and employees with prior Central Government approval.
applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
notes: This requirement allows the Board to function efficiently by appointing necessary personnel.

requirement: The Chairperson, Members, officers, and employees of the Data Protection Board shall be deemed public servants under the Indian Penal Code.
checkable_test: Verify if the Chairperson, Members, officers, and employees of the Board are deemed public servants under the Indian Penal Code.
applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
notes: This requirement grants the Board members and staff the status of public servants, ensuring accountability and legal protections.

requirement: The Board has the authority to investigate complaints made by Data Principals regarding breaches of obligations by Data Fiduciaries or Consent Managers and impose penalties as provided by the Act.
checkable_test: Check if the governance document outlines procedures for investigating complaints and imposing penalties for breaches by Data Fiduciaries or Consent Managers.
applicability: Applicable to any organization that is a Data Fiduciary or Consent Manager.
notes: This obligation is derived from the powers granted to the Board under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Board or its officers shall not prevent access to any premises or take into custody any equipment or item that may adversely affect the day-to-day functioning of a person.
checkable_test: Check if the governance document includes a policy that prohibits preventing access to premises or taking custody of equipment that affects day-to-day operations.
applicability: Applicable to any organization that is a Data Fiduciary or intermediary.
notes: This obligation is derived from the restrictions on the Board's powers under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Central Government may require the Board and any Data Fiduciary or intermediary to furnish information as it may call for.
checkable_test: Check if the governance document includes a policy that allows the Central Government to request information from the Board, Data Fiduciaries, or intermediaries.
applicability: Applicable to any organization that is a Data Fiduciary or intermediary.
notes: This obligation is derived from the government's authority to request information under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Central Government may, in the interests of the general public, direct any agency of the Central Government or any intermediary to block access to information generated, transmitted, received, stored, or hosted in any computer resource, after giving an opportunity of being heard to the Data Fiduciary.
checkable_test: Check if the governance document includes a policy that allows the Central Government to direct intermediaries to block access to information in the public interest.
applicability: Applicable to any organization that is an intermediary.
notes: This obligation is derived from the government's authority to block access to information under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Central Government may require the Board to advise on the manner in which the notice given by the Data Fiduciary to a Data Principal shall inform her, under sub-section (1) of section 5.
checkable_test: Check if the governance document includes a policy that outlines the manner in which notices to Data Principals must be provided under section 5(1) of the DPDP Act 2023.
applicability: Applicable to any organization that is a Data Fiduciary.
notes: This obligation is derived from the Central Government's authority to set notice requirements under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Central Government may require the Board to advise on the manner in which the notice given by the Data Fiduciary to a Data Principal shall inform her, under sub-section (2) of section 5.
checkable_test: Check if the governance document includes a policy that outlines the manner in which notices to Data Principals must be provided under section 5(2) of the DPDP Act 2023.
applicability: Applicable to any organization that is a Data Fiduciary.
notes: This obligation is derived from the Central Government's authority to set notice requirements under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Significant Data Fiduciaries must undertake other measures as specified under sub-clause (iii) of clause (c) of sub-section (2) of section 10.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies the other measures that Significant Data Fiduciaries must undertake as per the referenced sub-clause.
applicability: Applicable to Significant Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Data Principals must make a request to the Data Fiduciary for erasure of personal data in the manner specified under sub-section (3) of section 12.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies the manner in which Data Principals can request erasure of personal data as per the referenced sub-section.
applicability: Applicable to Data Principals and Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must respond to grievances within the period specified under sub-section (2) of section 13.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies the time period within which grievances must be responded to as per the referenced sub-section.
applicability: Applicable to Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must give notice to the Board or affected Data Principal in case of a personal data breach under sub-section (6) of section 8.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies the obligation to notify the Board or affected Data Principal in case of a personal data breach as per the referenced sub-section.
applicability: Applicable to Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A data fiduciary must ensure that personal data is processed in a manner that respects the rights and interests of data principals.
checkable_test: Verify that the definition of 'personal data' is clearly stated and aligns with the Act's requirements.
applicability: All data fiduciaries processing personal data.
notes: This clause defines 'personal data' and is foundational for understanding obligations under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must obtain consent from the Data Principal before processing personal data.
source: DPDP Act 2023, Section 3(OBLIGATIONS OF DATA FIDUCIARY)(a)
checkable_test: Check if the document explicitly states that consent must be obtained from the Data Principal before processing personal data.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries processing personal data.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to obtain consent under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary may process personal data for certain legitimate uses without explicit consent.
source: DPDP Act 2023, Section 3(OBLIGATIONS OF DATA FIDUCIARY)(b)
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies legitimate uses of personal data that do not require explicit consent.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries processing personal data for legitimate purposes.
notes: This requirement outlines the exceptions to the consent requirement under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Data Fiduciary must inform the Data Principal of the personal data processed and the purpose for which it was processed.
checkable_test: Verify that the document explicitly states the personal data processed and the purpose of processing.
applicability: Applies to all data fiduciaries processing personal data.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to disclose data processing purposes under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Data Fiduciary must inform the Data Principal of the manner in which they may exercise their rights under section 6 and section 13.
checkable_test: Verify that the document provides clear instructions on how the Data Principal can exercise their rights under the DPDP Act 2023.
applicability: Applies to all data fiduciaries processing personal data.
notes: This requirement ensures transparency in the process of exercising data rights.

requirement: The Data Fiduciary must inform the Data Principal of the manner in which they may make a complaint to the Data Protection Board.
checkable_test: Verify that the document provides clear instructions on how the Data Principal can file a complaint with the Data Protection Board.
applicability: Applies to all data fiduciaries processing personal data.
notes: This requirement ensures that Data Principals have a clear pathway for grievance redressal.

requirement: The Data Fiduciary must inform the Data Principal of the procedure for making a complaint to the Data Protection Board.
checkable_test: Verify that the document provides clear instructions on how the Data Principal can file a complaint with the Data Protection Board.
applicability: Applies to all data fiduciaries processing personal data.
notes: This requirement ensures that Data Principals have a clear pathway for grievance redressal.

requirement: Data principals must be informed of the grounds for processing their personal data.
checkable_test: Check if the document provides a notice informing data principals of the grounds for processing their personal data.
applicability: Applicable to all data processing activities under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation under Section 4(1) of the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Consent that infringes on the provisions of the DPDP Act or other applicable laws is invalid.
checkable_test: Check if the document states that any consent infringing on the DPDP Act or other laws is invalid.
applicability: Applicable to all data processing activities involving consent under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation under Section 4(2) of the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Processing of personal data is permitted for the performance of functions under any law for the time being in force in India, in the interest of sovereignty and integrity of India, or for security of the State.
checkable_test: Check if the document states that processing is allowed for functions under any law for the time being in force in India, in the interest of sovereignty and integrity of India, or for security of the State.
applicability: Applicable to data processing activities under the DPDP Act 2023 for state functions.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation under Section 4(c) of the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Processing of personal data is permitted for compliance with any judgment, decree, or order issued under any law for the time being in force in India, or any judgment or order relating to claims of a contractual or civil nature under any law for the time being in force outside India.
checkable_test: Check if the document states that processing is allowed for compliance with judgments, decrees, or orders under any law for the time being in force in India or outside India.
applicability: Applicable to data processing activities under the DPDP Act 2023 for compliance with legal orders.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation under Section 4(e) of the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Processing of personal data is permitted for responding to a medical emergency involving a threat to the life or immediate threat to the health of the Data Principal or any other individual.
checkable_test: Check if the document states that processing is allowed for responding to a medical emergency involving a threat to life or health.
applicability: Applicable to data processing activities under the DPDP Act 2023 for medical emergencies.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation under Section 4(f) of the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Processing of personal data is permitted for taking measures to ensure safety of, or provide assistance or services to, any individual during any disaster or breakdown of public order.
checkable_test: Check if the document states that processing is allowed for taking measures to ensure safety or provide assistance during a disaster or breakdown of public order.
applicability: Applicable to data processing activities under the DPDP Act 2023 for disaster or public order scenarios.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation under Section 4(h) of the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Processing of personal data is permitted if it is used to make a decision that affects the Data Principal.
checkable_test: Check if the document states that processing is allowed if it is used to make a decision that affects the Data Principal.
applicability: Applicable to data processing activities under the DPDP Act 2023 for decisions affecting the Data Principal.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation under Section 4(a) of the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure effective observance of the provisions of this Act and the rules made thereunder.
checkable_test: Verify that the document specifies technical and organisational measures to ensure compliance with the Act and its rules.
applicability: All Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This obligation is core to data protection and requires specific measures to be outlined in the governance document.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary shall, unless retention is necessary for compliance with any law for the time being in force, delete or anonymise personal data once the specified purpose is no longer being served.
checkable_test: Verify that the document specifies conditions and procedures for deleting or anonymising data when the purpose is no longer served.
applicability: All Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This obligation requires a clear retention and erasure policy aligned with the Act.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary shall cause its Data Processor to erase any personal data that was made available by the Data Fiduciary for processing to such Data Processor.
checkable_test: Verify that the document specifies procedures for erasing data shared with Data Processors.
applicability: All Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This obligation applies to data shared with third-party processors and requires specific erasure mechanisms.

requirement: A Significant Data Fiduciary shall assess the volume and sensitivity of personal data processed to determine its status as a Significant Data Fiduciary.
checkable_test: Verify that the document outlines the criteria and process for assessing whether a Data Fiduciary is classified as Significant.
applicability: Significant Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This is a core obligation for determining the obligations of Significant Data Fiduciaries.

requirement: A Significant Data Fiduciary shall consider the volume and sensitivity of personal data processed, as well as the potential impact on the sovereignty and integrity of India, in determining its status as a Significant Data Fiduciary.
checkable_test: Verify that the document specifies the factors, including potential impact on sovereignty and integrity, used to determine Significant Data Fiduciary status.
applicability: Significant Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This obligation is critical for assessing the obligations of Significant Data Fiduciaries under the Act.

requirement: The Significant Data Fiduciary must appoint an independent data auditor to conduct data audits and evaluate compliance with the Act.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the appointment of an independent data auditor for compliance evaluation.
applicability: Applies to Significant Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the requirement for data audit and compliance evaluation.

requirement: The Data Fiduciary must provide a summary of personal data being processed and the processing activities undertaken.
checkable_test: Verify if the document includes a summary of personal data processed and the associated processing activities.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This requirement is part of the data principal's right to access their personal data.

requirement: The Data Fiduciary must disclose the identities of all other Data Fiduciaries and Data Processors with whom personal data has been shared, along with a description of the data shared.
checkable_test: Check if the document lists all Data Fiduciaries and Data Processors with whom personal data has been shared, along with a description of the data shared.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This requirement is part of the data principal's right to know who has access to their personal data.

requirement: Data Principal must ensure not to impersonate another person while providing her personal data for a specified purpose.
checkable_test: Verify if the document explicitly states that Data Principals must not impersonate others when providing personal data for a specified purpose.
applicability: Applies to all Data Principals under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Data Principal must ensure not to suppress any material information while providing her personal data for any document, unique identifier, proof of identity or proof of address issued by the State or any of its instrumentalities.
checkable_test: Verify if the document explicitly states that Data Principals must not suppress material information when providing personal data for official documents or identifiers.
applicability: Applies to all Data Principals under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Data Principal must comply with the provisions of all applicable laws for the time being in force while exercising rights under the provisions of this Act.
checkable_test: Verify if the document explicitly states that Data Principals must comply with all applicable laws while exercising their rights under the DPDP Act 2023.
applicability: Applies to all Data Principals under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Data Fiduciary must exercise the rights of the Data Principal in accordance with the provisions of this Act and the rules made thereunder upon receipt of a request for erasure of personal data.
checkable_test: Verify if the document explicitly states that the Data Fiduciary must exercise the Data Principal's rights in accordance with the DPDP Act and its rules upon a request for erasure.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Data Fiduciary must correct the inaccurate or misleading personal data.
checkable_test: Verify if the document explicitly states that the Data Fiduciary must correct inaccurate or misleading personal data.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Data Fiduciary must complete the incomplete personal data.
checkable_test: Verify if the document explicitly states that the Data Fiduciary must complete incomplete personal data.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Data Fiduciary must update the personal data.
checkable_test: Verify if the document explicitly states that the Data Fiduciary must update personal data.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Principal must provide only verifiably authentic information and exercise the right to correction or erasure as provided under the Act or its rules.
checkable_test: Verify if the document requires users to provide only authentic information and allows correction or erasure of personal data as per the Act.
applicability: Applies to all data principals under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Principal has the right to correction and erasure of personal data as provided under the Act or its rules.
checkable_test: Verify if the document allows users to correct or erase their personal data as per the Act.
applicability: Applies to all data principals under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Principal has the right to grievance redressal as provided under the Act or its rules.
checkable_test: Verify if the document provides a mechanism for users to raise grievances and obtain redressal as per the Act.
applicability: Applies to all data principals under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Principal has the right to nominate as provided under the Act or its rules.
checkable_test: Verify if the document allows users to nominate a representative to exercise their data rights as per the Act.
applicability: Applies to all data principals under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Processing of personal data is necessary for enforcing any legal right or claim.
checkable_test: Verify if the document allows processing of personal data for enforcing legal rights or claims.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries processing data for legal enforcement.

requirement: Processing of personal data by courts, tribunals, or regulatory bodies is necessary for the performance of their functions.
checkable_test: Verify if the document allows processing of personal data by judicial or regulatory bodies for their functions.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries processing data for judicial or regulatory functions.

requirement: Processing of personal data is necessary for the prevention, detection, investigation, or prosecution of any offence or contravention of law in India.
checkable_test: Verify if the document allows processing of personal data for law enforcement or criminal investigations.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries processing data for law enforcement purposes.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must ensure that personal data of Data Principals not within the territory of India is processed pursuant to any contract entered into with any person outside the territory of India by any person based in India.
checkable_test: Verify that the processing of personal data of Data Principals outside India is done under a contract with a person outside India.
applicability: When a data fiduciary processes personal data of Data Principals not within India.
notes: This clause outlines an exemption for processing personal data of Data Principals outside India under a contract with a person outside India.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must ensure that processing is necessary for a scheme of compromise or arrangement or merger or amalgamation of two or more companies or a reconstruction by way of demerger or otherwise of a company, or transfer of undertaking of one or more company to another company, or involving division of one or more companies, approved by a court or tribunal or other authority competent to do so by any law for the time being in force.
checkable_test: Verify that the processing is necessary for a scheme of compromise, arrangement, merger, amalgamation, reconstruction, or transfer of undertaking approved by a competent authority.
applicability: When processing is for a scheme of compromise, arrangement, merger, amalgamation, reconstruction, or transfer of undertaking.
notes: This clause outlines an exemption for processing personal data for specific corporate restructuring activities approved by a competent authority.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must ensure that processing is for the purpose of ascertaining the financial information and assets and liabilities of any person who has defaulted in payment due on account of a loan or advance taken from a financial institution, subject to such processing being in accordance with the provisions regarding disclosure of information or data in any other law for the time being in force.
checkable_test: Verify that the processing is for ascertaining financial information and assets and liabilities of a person who has defaulted on a loan or advance from a financial institution, in accordance with other applicable laws.
applicability: When processing is for financial information of a person who has defaulted on a loan or advance.
notes: This clause outlines an exemption for processing personal data for financial information of a person who has defaulted on a loan or advance, subject to other laws.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must ensure that processing of personal data outside India is exempted under the provisions of the Act.
checkable_test: Verify that the processing of personal data outside India is exempted under the provisions of the Act.
applicability: When processing personal data outside India.
notes: This clause outlines an exemption for processing personal data outside India.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must ensure that processing of personal data outside India is exempted under the provisions of the Act.
source: DPDP Act 2023, Section Special Provisions 31 of 2016
checkable_test: Verify that the processing of personal data outside India is exempted under the provisions of the Act.
applicability: When processing personal data outside India.
notes: This clause outlines an exemption for processing personal data outside India.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must ensure that processing of personal data is necessary for research, archiving, or statistical purposes if the personal data is not to be used to take any decision specific to a Data Principal and such processing is carried on in accordance with such standards as may be prescribed.
checkable_test: Verify that the processing is necessary for research, archiving, or statistical purposes and that it is not used to take decisions specific to a Data Principal, in accordance with prescribed standards.
applicability: When processing personal data for research, archiving, or statistical purposes.
notes: This clause outlines an exemption for processing personal data for research, archiving, or statistical purposes, provided it is not used for specific decisions.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must ensure that the Data Protection Board of India is established in accordance with the provisions of the Act.
source: DPDP Act 2023, Section Data Protection Board of India Establishment of Board
checkable_test: Verify that the Data Protection Board of India is established in accordance with the Act.
applicability: When establishing the Data Protection Board of India.
notes: This clause outlines the requirement for establishing the Data Protection Board of India.

requirement: The Data Protection Board of India must investigate and impose penalties for personal data breaches as provided by the DPDP Act 2023.
checkable_test: Check if the Data Protection Board has authority to investigate and impose penalties for personal data breaches.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This obligation is tied to the powers of the Data Protection Board under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Data Protection Board of India must investigate and impose penalties for personal data breaches, including those involving a Consent Manager, as provided by the DPDP Act 2023.
checkable_test: Check if the Data Protection Board has authority to investigate and impose penalties for personal data breaches involving a Consent Manager.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This obligation is tied to the powers of the Data Protection Board under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Data Protection Board of India must investigate and impose penalties for personal data breaches referred by the Central Government, as provided by the DPDP Act 2023.
checkable_test: Check if the Data Protection Board has authority to investigate and impose penalties for personal data breaches referred by the Central Government.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This obligation is tied to the powers of the Data Protection Board under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Data Protection Board of India may issue directions to data principals, after providing an opportunity to be heard and recording reasons in writing, as provided by the DPDP Act 2023.
checkable_test: Check if the Data Protection Board has authority to issue directions to data principals after providing an opportunity to be heard and recording reasons in writing.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This obligation is tied to the powers of the Data Protection Board under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Data Protection Board of India may modify, suspend, withdraw, or cancel directions issued to data principals, subject to conditions, as provided by the DPDP Act 2023.
checkable_test: Check if the Data Protection Board has authority to modify, suspend, withdraw, or cancel directions issued to data principals, subject to conditions.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This obligation is tied to the powers of the Data Protection Board under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Data Protection Board of India must function as an independent body and adopt techno-legal measures to ensure digital operations, as provided by the DPDP Act 2023.
checkable_test: Check if the Data Protection Board is required to function as an independent body and adopt techno-legal measures for digital operations.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This obligation is tied to the powers of the Data Protection Board under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Board must conduct inquiries into data fiduciaries' compliance with the DPDP Act following the principles of natural justice.
checkable_test: Whether the Board conducts inquiries into data fiduciaries' compliance with the DPDP Act following the principles of natural justice.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act.
notes: This requirement is derived from the obligation to inquire into compliance with the Act.

requirement: The Board must provide reasons for its actions during the course of an inquiry.
checkable_test: Whether the Board provides reasons for its actions during the course of an inquiry.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act.
notes: This requirement is derived from the obligation to record reasons for actions during an inquiry.

requirement: The Board must have the same powers as a civil court under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, for matters relating to data compliance.
checkable_test: Whether the Board has the same powers as a civil court under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, for data compliance matters.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act.
notes: This requirement is derived from the obligation to have the same powers as a civil court for data compliance.

requirement: The Board must inspect data, books, documents, and other records of data fiduciaries as part of its functions.
checkable_test: Whether the Board inspects data, books, documents, and other records of data fiduciaries as part of its functions.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act.
notes: This requirement is derived from the obligation to inspect data and records of data fiduciaries.

requirement: The Board may issue interim orders during an inquiry, after giving the person concerned an opportunity of being heard.
checkable_test: Whether the Board issues interim orders during an inquiry after providing the person concerned an opportunity of being heard.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act.
notes: This requirement is derived from the obligation to issue interim orders after providing an opportunity of being heard.

requirement: The Board may close proceedings or proceed under section 33 after giving the person concerned an opportunity of being heard.
checkable_test: Check if the Board provides an opportunity for the person concerned to be heard before closing proceedings or proceeding under section 33.
applicability: Applicable to complaints under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause outlines the procedural requirement for the Board to provide an opportunity for the person concerned to be heard before taking action.

requirement: The Board may issue a warning or impose costs on a complainant if it deems the complaint false or frivolous.
checkable_test: Verify if the Board has the authority to issue a warning or impose costs on a complainant for a false or frivolous complaint.
applicability: Applicable to complaints under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause establishes the Board's authority to take action against false or frivolous complaints.

requirement: The Appellate Tribunal may entertain an appeal after the expiry of the period specified in sub-section (2) if there was sufficient cause for not preferring the appeal within that period.
checkable_test: Check if the Appellate Tribunal allows appeals after the expiry of the specified period if there was sufficient cause for delay.
applicability: Applicable to appeals under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause outlines the conditions under which the Appellate Tribunal may entertain an appeal after the expiry of the specified period.

requirement: The Appellate Tribunal shall record its reasons in writing for not disposing of an appeal within six months.
checkable_test: Verify if the Appellate Tribunal records its reasons in writing for not disposing of an appeal within six months.
applicability: Applicable to appeals under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause mandates the Appellate Tribunal to record reasons for delays in disposing of appeals.

requirement: The Appellate Tribunal shall deal with an appeal under this section in accordance with such procedure as may be prescribed.
checkable_test: Check if the Appellate Tribunal follows prescribed procedures for handling appeals under this section.
applicability: Applicable to appeals under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause requires the Appellate Tribunal to follow prescribed procedures for handling appeals.

requirement: The provisions of section 18 of the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997 shall apply.
checkable_test: Verify if the provisions of section 18 of the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997 apply to appeals under this section.
applicability: Applicable to appeals under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause mandates the application of section 18 of the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997 to appeals under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: An order passed by the Appellate Tribunal under this Act shall be executable by it as a decree of civil court.
checkable_test: Check if the Appellate Tribunal's order is executable as a decree of civil court.
applicability: Applicable to orders passed by the Appellate Tribunal under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause establishes the executability of the Appellate Tribunal's orders as decrees of civil court.

requirement: The Board may direct the parties concerned to attempt resolution of the dispute through mediation if it deems the complaint may be resolved by mediation.
checkable_test: Verify if the Board has the authority to direct parties to resolve disputes through mediation if it deems the complaint may be resolved by mediation.
applicability: Applicable to complaints under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause outlines the Board's authority to direct mediation for resolving disputes.

requirement: A data fiduciary must comply with terms of a voluntary undertaking accepted by the Board, as non-compliance is deemed a breach of the Act.
checkable_test: Verify if the data fiduciary has adhered to the terms of any voluntary undertaking accepted by the Board.
applicability: Applicable to any data fiduciary that has accepted a voluntary undertaking under the Act.
notes: This obligation is tied to the consequences of non-compliance with a voluntary undertaking accepted by the Board.

requirement: The Board may vary the terms of a voluntary undertaking accepted by a data fiduciary, provided it has the consent of the data fiduciary.
checkable_test: Check if the Board has modified the terms of a voluntary undertaking with the consent of the data fiduciary.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries who have accepted a voluntary undertaking under the Act.
notes: This obligation outlines the conditions under which the Board may alter the terms of a voluntary undertaking.

requirement: The Board may impose penalties under the Act if a data fiduciary breaches its provisions or the rules made thereunder, and the breach is deemed significant.
checkable_test: Verify if the Board has imposed penalties for a significant breach of the Act or its rules.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries that have breached the Act or its rules.
notes: This obligation outlines the Board's authority to impose penalties for significant breaches of the Act.

requirement: The Board must specify the type and nature of personal data affected by a breach when issuing orders under the Act.
checkable_test: Check if the Board has included details about the type and nature of personal data affected by a breach in its orders.
applicability: Applicable to the Board when issuing orders related to breaches under the Act.
notes: This obligation requires the Board to provide specific information about the data affected by a breach.

requirement: Penalties imposed by the Board under the Act must be credited to the Consolidated Fund of India.
checkable_test: Verify if penalties imposed by the Board are credited to the Consolidated Fund of India.
applicability: Applicable to all penalties imposed by the Board under the Act.
notes: This obligation outlines the financial handling of penalties imposed by the Board under the Act.

requirement: No legal proceedings may be initiated against the Central Government, the Board, its Chairperson, or its Members, officers, or employees for actions taken in good faith under the Act or its rules.
checkable_test: Check if legal proceedings have been initiated against the Central Government, the Board, or its officials for actions taken in good faith under the Act.
applicability: Applicable to the Central Government, the Board, its Chairperson, and its Members, officers, or employees.
notes: This obligation protects the Central Government and the Board from legal action for actions taken in good faith under the Act.

requirement: The Central Government or its authorized officers may take action upon a written reference from the Board regarding specific matters under the Act.
checkable_test: Verify if the Central Government or its authorized officers have taken action based on a written reference from the Board.
applicability: Applicable to the Central Government and its authorized officers when receiving a reference from the Board.
notes: This obligation outlines the Central Government's authority to act on references from the Board under the Act.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must not initiate legal proceedings against the Central Board for penalties imposed under the DPDP Act 2023.
checkable_test: Verify if the data fiduciary is prohibited from initiating legal proceedings against the Central Board for penalties.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause establishes a prohibition on legal action against the Central Board for penalties imposed under the Act.

requirement: Intermediaries must comply with directions issued by the Central Board under the DPDP Act 2023.
checkable_test: Verify if the intermediary is required to comply with directions issued by the Central Board.
applicability: Applicable to intermediaries under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause mandates compliance with directions issued by the Central Board by intermediaries.

requirement: The Board must be informed of personal data breaches in the manner specified under the DPDP Act 2023.
checkable_test: Verify if the data fiduciary is required to inform the Board of personal data breaches in the specified manner.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause mandates the specific manner in which personal data breaches must be reported to the Board.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must obtain verifiable consent for processing personal data of children, including the purposes of processing.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies a method for obtaining verifiable consent for children's data processing.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries processing children's personal data.

requirement: Data Principals must be able to request information related to their personal data and its processing.
checkable_test: Check if the document allows Data Principals to request information about their personal data and its processing.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries handling personal data of Data Principals.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must specify the classes of Data Fiduciaries and the conditions for processing personal data of children.
checkable_test: Check if the document defines the classes of Data Fiduciaries and the conditions for processing children's personal data.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries processing children's personal data.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must conduct a Data Protection Impact Assessment for processing personal data under specific conditions.
checkable_test: Check if the document outlines the process for conducting a Data Protection Impact Assessment for specific data processing activities.
applicability: Applies to Significant Data Fiduciaries processing personal data under specific conditions.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must specify the standards for processing personal data for exemption under specific provisions.
checkable_test: Check if the document outlines the standards for processing personal data for exemption under specific provisions.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries processing personal data under exemption provisions.

requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must be based in India.
checkable_test: Verify whether the data fiduciary is physically located in India.
applicability: Applies to significant data fiduciaries.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the physical location of the data fiduciary.

requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must undergo periodic audits.
checkable_test: Verify whether the data fiduciary has a documented audit process and schedule.
applicability: Applies to significant data fiduciaries.
notes: This requirement mandates regular audits as part of data fiduciary obligations.

requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must implement such other measures, consistent with the provisions of this Act, as may be prescribed.
checkable_test: Verify whether the data fiduciary has implemented additional measures as required by the Act.
applicability: Applies to significant data fiduciaries.
notes: This requirement allows for additional measures as prescribed by the Act.

requirement: The provisions of Chapter II, except sub-sections (1) and (5) of section 8, and those of Chapter III and section 16 shall not apply where—
checkable_test: Verify whether the specific provisions of the Act are excluded from application in the specified circumstances.
applicability: Applies to situations where the provisions of Chapter II and III are excluded.
notes: This clause outlines exceptions to the application of certain provisions of the Act.

requirement: The Chairperson and Members of the Data Protection Board must meet specific qualifications for appointment.
source: DPDP Act 2023, SECTION=Composition and qualifications for appointment of
checkable_test: Verify whether the qualifications for the appointment of the Chairperson and Members are met.
applicability: Applies to the appointment of the Data Protection Board members.
notes: This requirement outlines the qualifications for the appointment of the Data Protection Board members.

requirement: The Chairperson and Members of the Data Protection Board must receive specific salary and allowances and have a defined term of office.
source: DPDP Act 2023, SECTION=Composition and qualifications for appointment of
checkable_test: Verify whether the salary, allowances, and term of office for the Chairperson and Members are defined and met.
applicability: Applies to the appointment of the Data Protection Board members.
notes: This requirement outlines the financial and tenure terms for the Data Protection Board members.

requirement: The Chairperson or a Member of the Data Protection Board must not have been convicted of an offence involving moral turpitude.
source: DPDP Act 2023, SECTION=Chairperson or a Member, if she— (b)
checkable_test: Verify whether the Chairperson or Member has a criminal record involving moral turpitude.
applicability: Applies to the appointment of the Data Protection Board members.
notes: This requirement prohibits the appointment of individuals with a criminal record involving moral turpitude.

requirement: The Chairperson or a Member of the Data Protection Board must not have abused their position to the extent that their continuance in office is prejudicial to the public interest.
source: DPDP Act 2023, SECTION=Chairperson or a Member, if she— (e)
checkable_test: Verify whether the Chairperson or Member has a history of abusing their position to the detriment of public interest.
applicability: Applies to the appointment of the Data Protection Board members.
notes: This requirement prohibits the appointment of individuals who have abused their position to the detriment of public interest.

requirement: The Board shall determine whether there are sufficient grounds to proceed with an inquiry.
checkable_test: Whether the Board has a process to determine if there are sufficient grounds to initiate an inquiry.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause outlines the Board's responsibility to assess the validity of inquiries related to data protection compliance.

requirement: Any person aggrieved by an order or direction made by the Board under this Act may prefer an appeal before the Appellate Tribunal.
checkable_test: Whether a person has the right to appeal an order or direction issued by the Board.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause establishes the right of appeal for individuals affected by decisions made by the Board.

requirement: Every appeal under sub-section (1) shall be filed within a period of sixty days from the date of receipt of the order or direction appealed against.
checkable_test: Whether the appeal process has a defined time limit for filing an appeal.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause specifies the time frame within which an appeal must be filed against a Board order or direction.

requirement: On receipt of an appeal under sub-section (1), the Appellate Tribunal may, after giving the parties to the appeal, an opportunity of being heard, pass such orders thereon as it thinks fit, confirming, modifying or setting aside the order appealed against.
checkable_test: Whether the Appellate Tribunal provides an opportunity for the parties to be heard during the appeal process.
applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This clause outlines the Appellate Tribunal's authority to review and modify orders issued by the Board.

requirement: The Appellate Tribunal must function as a digital office, ensuring that the receipt of appeals, hearings, and decision pronouncement are conducted digitally.
checkable_test: Verify if the Appellate Tribunal's processes for handling appeals are designed to be digital.
applicability: Applicable to all appeals filed under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This requirement focuses on the digital transformation of the Appellate Tribunal's operations.

requirement: The Appellate Tribunal must dispose of appeals finally within six months from the date of receipt.
checkable_test: Check if the Appellate Tribunal has a policy to resolve appeals within six months.
applicability: Applicable to all appeals filed under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This requirement sets a time limit for the resolution of appeals.

requirement: The Appellate Tribunal must ensure that the acceptance of a voluntary undertaking by the Board bars proceedings under the Act regarding the contents of the undertaking, except in cases covered by sub-section (5).
checkable_test: Verify if the acceptance of a voluntary undertaking by the Board prevents further proceedings under the Act, except in specified cases.
applicability: Applicable to voluntary undertakings accepted by the Board under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This requirement outlines the effect of accepting a voluntary undertaking by the Board.

requirement: The Board must consider the nature, gravity, and duration of the breach when determining the amount of monetary penalty.
checkable_test: Check if the Board's penalty determination includes consideration of the nature, gravity, and duration of the breach.
applicability: Applicable to all breaches subject to monetary penalties under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This requirement outlines a factor to be considered in determining penalties for breaches.

requirement: The Board must consider the repetitive nature of the breach when determining the amount of monetary penalty.
checkable_test: Verify if the Board's penalty determination includes consideration of the repetitive nature of the breach.
applicability: Applicable to all breaches subject to monetary penalties under the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This requirement outlines a factor to be considered in determining penalties for breaches.

requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must ensure that monetary penalties imposed for breaches are proportionate and effective, taking into account the need to deter and secure observance of the Act.
checkable_test: Check if the penalty imposed for a breach is proportionate and effective.
applicability: Applicable to significant data fiduciaries.
notes: This requirement is derived from the obligation to ensure penalties are proportionate and effective.

requirement: The Data Principal must specify the time period for the specified purpose to be deemed as no longer being served.
checkable_test: Check if the time period for the purpose is specified in the document.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries handling personal data.
notes: This obligation relates to the duration of data processing for a specific purpose.

requirement: The Data Principal must nominate any other individual as per the specified manner.
checkable_test: Verify if the document outlines the manner of nomination of an individual by the Data Principal.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries handling personal data.
notes: This obligation is related to the process of nominating an individual by the Data Principal.

requirement: The Chairperson and other Members of the Board must be appointed in the manner specified.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the manner of appointment of the Chairperson and other Members of the Board.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries handling personal data.
notes: This obligation relates to the appointment process of the Board members.

requirement: The terms and conditions of appointment and service of officers and employees of the Board must be specified.
checkable_test: Verify if the document outlines the terms and conditions of appointment and service of officers and employees of the Board.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries handling personal data.
notes: This obligation is related to the appointment and service terms of the Board officers and employees.

requirement: The document must specify the other matters under clause (d) of sub-section (7) of section 28.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the other matters under clause (d) of sub-section (7) of section 28.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries handling personal data.
notes: This obligation relates to the specification of other matters under section 28.

requirement: The document must specify any other matter which is to be or may be prescribed or in respect of which provision is to be, or may be, made by rules.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies any other matter which is to be or may be prescribed or in respect of which provision is to be, or may be, made by rules.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries handling personal data.
notes: This obligation is related to the specification of other matters under section 28.

requirement: Any amendment notified under sub-section (1) shall have effect as if enacted in this Act and shall come into force on the date of the notification.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies that any amendment notified under sub-section (1) shall have effect as if enacted in this Act and shall come into force on the date of the notification.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries handling personal data.
notes: This obligation relates to the effect and implementation of amendments under section 28.
